messages:
Priya: quick follow-up from last night's incident. I compiled action items so we can track ownership and SLO changes.

Jamal: paste the items?

Priya: 1) Temporary SLO shift: p95 -> 220ms (was 200ms) while we stabilize cache; owner Jamal; due 2024-11-20. 2) Dashboard: add prefix cache hit-rate, p50/p95/p99 trend, per-model tail heatmap; owner Lucia; due 2024-11-27. 3) Runbook: distinguish cache-warm vs cold, include automated KV dump; owner Morgan; due 2024-11-21. 4) Error budget alert: add paging policy + escalation; owner Morgan + Priya; due 2024-11-25. 5) Synthetic canary: low-frequency job to exercise warm path; owner Lucia; due 2024-11-22.

Lucia: I'll create panels: prefix_cache_gauge, p95_trend, per_model_tail. will add a synthetic hit-rate panel wired to canary job. dashboard link (wip): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency/case-2142680

Morgan: runbook will include this snippet to collect kv stats:
```bash
# gather kv cache sizes
rdw-cache-inspect --model all --output brief
```
I'll also add escalation steps for cache cold starts.

Jamal: SLO PR incoming. wording suggestion for customer doc: "Committed latency: p95 <= 220ms for standard requests; 99.9% availability with graceful degradation." I'll include audit note referencing incident 2024-11-19. PR ETA 2024-11-20 EOD.

Priya: on paging behavior for error-budget-burn: propose critical -> page SRE primary, high -> slack only unless sustained 15m. Morgan owns config.

Morgan: agreed. i'll set alert tags and add to runbook.

oncall-bot: Incident #2024-11-19-17 closed by Jamal. Postmortem queued.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: dashboard/latency-panels by Lucia -> staging. ETA 2024-11-22 03:00 UTC.

Priya: summary timeline: SLO PR (Jamal) 11/20, runbook (Morgan) 11/21, canary + deploy (Lucia) 11/22, dashboard final (Lucia) 11/27, alerts (Priya+Morgan) 11/25. i'll add these to the postmortem tracker and ping daily until closed. :thumbsup:

Lucia: quick q  do we want the dashboard to mark days where p95 exceeded SLO and annotate with deploys? can add hover notes.

Jamal: yes annotate with deploy IDs and incident link. that will help recurring pattern analysis.

Priya: ok closing this thread for now. owners please update the tracker card when you start work.
